title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Becoming the Third Eye

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(A king—one who protects the realm and loves the people.
One who brings hope solely through their own being.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(One who, with overwhelming prowess,
guides all toward a dazzling future.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (One who possesses the caliber to do so.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Do not waver, do not shrink back...!
If I have resolved to become king, then I—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (—The caliber of a king, is it...?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Aah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Buena! That was a fantastic run!”
“Lady Rose, a truly splendid race.”
“Thank you, Flash! Ruler!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I ran. I achieved results. And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To waver in the midst of battle.
How utterly feeble...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It is not enough.
Everything is lacking in who I am right now.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I must become stronger.
Stronger, stronger... stronger than anyone...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... have they
already taken their leave?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Once I have changed and seen to my errands, I shall join you immediately, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I thought my eyes were playing tricks on me—
but something really was off with her after the race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Even putting that aside,
I have frequently seen you lost in troubled thought lately.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I am worried.
I wonder if there is anything I can do.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...However, we lack the sources to decipher the situation.
There is insufficient data to make a judgment.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I am eager to act, but I will leave this to my Trainer.
From his vantage point, he should have many more cards to play.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I am eager to act, but I will leave this to my Trainer.
From her vantage point, she should have many more cards to play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen behind her, Rose Kingdom headed home as if pursued by something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the quiet car,
the occasional sound of wind rushing past the chassis echoed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For our next campaign, I wish to target the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.
Through overwhelming victory, I shall lead the Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Reconstruct our training process toward this objective.
Run it in a high-intensity cycle, and secure victory—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A victory so brilliant it will dazzle the eyes—that is what I shall seize.
choice_data_list: ……秋シニア三冠自体は、問題ありません
choice_data_list_en: ...The Autumn Senior Triple Crown itself isn't a problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Contending for the Senior GⅠ Triple Crown—the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen—is no easy feat, but that only makes the glory shine brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression right now is strikingly rigid.
Almost as if she is steeling her heart,
determined to remain unswayed by anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor after the race was strange as well.
It was by no means a poor run, yet her
expression remained clouded in gloom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...? What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did I let myself feel so reassured
by how she seemed after taking a break?
choice_data_list_en: ...Could I... speak with you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A talk?
choice_data_list_en: I speak of what lies in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I do nothing but make you worry about me.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I do nothing but borrow their aid and lean on their support.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me.
Did I cause you worry?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems the race had taken a toll.
Think nothing of it; it is of no consequence.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Only a single desire resides within my heart:
the everlasting tranquility of the Kingdom of the Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thus, in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I shall seize a dazzling victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The Rose Clan must have a strong king.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying she wanted to take in the scenery, she walked away,
and I couldn't bring myself to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't tell what was gnawing at her heart.
Yet whatever was undeniably there,
she concealed completely behind her smile.
choice_data_list: （誰よりも近くに仕える、俺にすら）
（誰よりも近くに仕える、私にすら）
choice_data_list_en: (Even to me, who serves closer to her than anyone...)
(Even to me, who serves closer to her than anyone...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A cold chill sank deep into my chest. Even after our break,
nothing had truly been resolved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed as though she had begun walking a solitary path.
Words of encouragement would be meaningless to her right now.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To see what our lady cannot and offer our support—
that is the duty of those who serve her.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: —You must become her third eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A top Trainer's words suddenly came back to me.
A "third eye"—in other words...
choice_data_list: （彼女に今、見えていないもの――とは？）
choice_data_list_en: (What is it that she can't see right now—?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words from earlier echo in my mind.
Her feelings toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn), her thirst for victory,
an uncharacteristic lie, and—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: 'The Rose Clan must have a strong monarch.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A devotion turned blind—born from the crushing weight of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was in the dead of night that day
when I rushed into the main estate.
choice_data_list: 彼女は、今ひとりで未来へ向かっています
choice_data_list_en: Right now, she is heading toward the future all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, the Rose Clan's trainers, led by their top trainer, listened to our circumstances with utmost care.
choice_data_list: 彼女に、みなさんの存在を思い出してほしい
choice_data_list_en: I want her to remember that all of you are here for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how it will lead to a solution. But
the Rose clan is her pillar of support. At the very least,
it might halt her current solitary march.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Please, lift your head.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
We are truly grateful from the bottom of our hearts
for everything the two of you have accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: She dedicates herself body and soul each and every day to sever the curse of thorns and bring peace to the Kingdom of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand... we have placed far too much
of the burden upon the two of you.
It is only natural, in a sense, that you would forget.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the decision to you and claiming
it was so as not to get in your way...
was, in truth, nothing more than a convenient excuse.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I must apologize for this oversight.
Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: This summer, let us demonstrate it. The true, unyielding mettle of the House of the Rose.
